newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs stable in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs stable in quiet trade.

text.p: Spot U.S. liquefied petroleum gas prices were largely steady in very quiet late trade on Tuesday amid stable NYMEX crude oil prices, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was pegged between 34.75 cents and 35.00 cents a gallon, slightly down from midday but unchanged from Monday's values.
Spot Conway, Kansas, material was stable at 35.25/35.50 cents in quiet trade.
The butane markets were also unchanged but sentiment was bearish in the U.S. Guf Coast due to imports of material heard coming from Mexico.
Belvieu butane was pegged 38.25/38.75 cents. 38.75 cents was done.
Conway, Kansas, normal butane held onto midday gains as players found a thinning but still profitable spread in shipping material to Belvieu.
